{"text":"ItemID: NA; Title: Fallen; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Its melodic heaviness fits, but I am more interested in riff-driven metal right now.
ItemID: NA; Title: City of Evil       Explicit Lyrics; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: The energetic riffs and elaborate guitar work fit my interest in Chuck and Advance And Vanquish.
ItemID: NA; Title: Meteora; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: Its mix of aggression and melodic hooks suits my interest in The Reason and Ten Thousand Fists.
ItemID: NA; Title: Hybrid Theory; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The heavy, catchy sound appeals, but I would choose Meteora this time rather than both.
ItemID: NA; Title: All the Right Reasons; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: It fits the accessible rock side of my history, but I want something heavier today.
ItemID: NA; Title: Believe       Explicit Lyrics; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: Having recently explored Ten Thousand Fists, I would try more of Disturbed's heavy riffs and melodic vocals.
ItemID: NA; Title: Saturate; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Its heavy melodic rock sounds appealing, but my stronger interests on this page take priority.
ItemID: NA; Title: The Sickness; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: More Disturbed interests me, but I would start with Believe rather than choose several albums at once.
ItemID: NA; Title: Three Days Grace; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: The forceful vocals and direct rock hooks fit my interest in Seventeen Days and One Day Remains.
ItemID: NA; Title: Death Magnetic; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The thrash direction fits my heavier listening, but City of Evil is my first metal pick this time."}
